citizen_summary.what_is_this_about: Urging BPDA to maintain its online database of programs and projects.
citizen_summary.is_it_binding: Resolutions express Parliament's official position or direct BARMM offices; unlike Autonomy Acts they generally do not create binding law for the public, but internal-rules resolutions bind the Parliament itself.

what_this_means_for_you.in_short: Res. 520 (2025): Urging BPDA to maintain its online database of programs and projects. An oversight/directive resolution: the Parliament instructing or urging a government office to act or report. This is where citizens' complaints often become official demands - if the subject touches your life, the addressed agency now owes an answer.

for_specific_groups.Affected residents: Reference this resolution when asking the agency what it has done
for_specific_groups.The addressed ministry: A reporting or action obligation to the Parliament

watch_out_for: Follow-through varies - Res 496 even created a tracking mechanism because so many resolutions went unanswered
what_this_means_for_you.where_this_applies: All of BARMM unless the title names a specific place
what_this_means_for_you.when_you_will_feel_it: Immediately as an official position; concrete action depends on the addressed agency
what_you_can_do: If the resolution urges an agency to act, cite it when following up with that agency
Share it - resolutions gain force through public attention
Ask your MP to follow through with legislation if the issue needs a binding law

key_terms_explained.Adopted resolution: An official position or instruction of the Parliament - persuasive and political, but not a law binding the public.
key_terms_explained.BAA: Bangsamoro Autonomy Act - a regional law passed by the Bangsamoro Parliament, applying inside BARMM alongside national laws.

benefits.headline: An agency now officially owes action or answers.

direct_benefits.benefit: Leverage: cite the resolution when demanding the directed action/report
direct_benefits.how_to_access: Quote it in letters/follow-ups to the agency

indirect_benefits: Repeated oversight builds a paper trail for reforms (or for the next budget debate)
limitations: Compliance varies; Res 496's tracking system exists because many go unanswered

citizen_questions.q: Does this resolution change the law?
citizen_questions.a: No - it expresses a position, urges, directs, or commends. Law changes require a Bangsamoro Autonomy Act.
